title: Component Creation Metadata Initialization (SEQUENCE, CREATED, DTSTAMP) on Store Addition

citations.verbatim_quote: The property can be specified once in "VEVENT", "VTODO", or "VJOURNAL" calendar components. The value MUST be specified as a date with UTC time. Description: This property specifies the date and time that the calendar information was created by the calendar user agent in the calendar store.
Conformance: This property MUST be included in the "VEVENT", "VTODO", "VJOURNAL", or "VFREEBUSY" calendar components. Description: The value MUST be specified in the UTC time format.

Description: When a calendar component is created, its sequence number is 0. It is monotonically incremented by the "Organizer's" CUA each time the "Organizer" makes a significant revision to the calendar component.

rationale: RFC 5545 Section 3.8.7.2 requires every VEVENT and VTODO component to include a UTC DTSTAMP property. Section 3.8.7.1 defines CREATED as the UTC date and time the component information was created in the calendar store, and Section 3.8.7.4 specifies that when a component is created in the store, its SEQUENCE number starts at 0. Therefore, adding a newly constructed component to the calendar store must populate DTSTAMP (in UTC), default CREATED to the initial DTSTAMP if not already set, and initialize SEQUENCE to 0 if not explicitly provided.
store_implication: When a new VEVENT or VTODO component is added to the calendar store: (1) its `dtstamp` defaults to the current UTC timestamp if not explicitly supplied; (2) if `created` is unset, `created` is initialized to the component's `dtstamp`; (3) if `sequence` is unset, `sequence` is initialized to 0 (preserving any explicit sequence number passed by the caller); (4) `last_modified` remains None on initial creation unless explicitly supplied. The resulting component in the calendar store and its expanded occurrences on the timeline carry `sequence=0`, `created=dtstamp`, and `dtstamp` in UTC.
edge_cases_and_counterexamples: If a caller supplies an explicit `sequence` (e.g. `sequence=3` when importing an existing component) or an explicit `created` timestamp, adding the component to the store must preserve those values rather than overwriting them with 0 or `dtstamp`.
Both `DTSTAMP` and `CREATED` must always carry the UTC timezone.
For a newly added recurring component, every expanded occurrence on the timeline inherits the initialized `sequence=0` (or explicit initial `sequence`).

scenarios.name: add_initializes_sequence_created_dtstamp
scenarios.description: Adding a new VEVENT with unset sequence and created populates sequence=0 and created=dtstamp.
